text:
Cairo is working with the state of Georgia to support affordable housing. The Georgia Initiative for Community Housing is part of Georgia's Department of Community Affairs and funded, in part, by USDA Rural Development.

https://t.co/fAWibnCGvb

As the top Democrat on the U.S. House Appropriations Subcommittee that oversees and funds USDA, I have continually fought for programs that support rural communities. Unfortunately, chaotic tariffs and the Administration’s distractions with unauthorized wars in the past year have distracted it from tackling housing affordability and disrupted supply chains.

Nonetheless, I voted with Democrats and Republicans to pass the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act which would tackle some of the underlying causes of high housing prices. It became law without President Trump’s signature.

And in January, as a senior leader of the U.S. House Appropriations Committee, I helped pass a bipartisan appropriations law that will help keep housing affordable and safe, including the HOME Investment Partnerships, Homeless Assistance Grant program, and Lead Hazard Reduction Grant Program.
